# Enpath Design System

> Enpath's design system — built on shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS v4, with a three-tier token architecture (Primitives → Semantics → Components), 55 documented components, and Storybook. No Figma: tokens, docs and code are the source. Light mode only.

**Storybook:** `http://localhost:6006` — 55 components (verification status in `Tracking/Storybook Status.md`)
**Code:** `enpath-ui/` — Next.js + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui. Lives as a subfolder of this monorepo (repo root → `enpath-ui/`). All `enpath-ui/...` paths below are relative to the repo root.

---

## Rules and Process

- `enpath-design-system.md`: The rulebook. Source of truth (where each thing lives, the gates), token layers, pointers to the token JSON (values are not restated), Token rules (cross-token rules: colour, spacing, height pairs and hit areas, app shell, text styles and their exceptions), component rules (use existing components, separation ladder), icons (Phosphor), accessibility (focus, target size), and the numbered R-ENP rules. No Figma — light mode only.
- `Skills/token-binding-skill.md`: **Read before binding any token in code.** How to pick a token by meaning (descriptions in `Tokens/semantics.tokens.json`), pairing rules, height pairs, adding a new token with the full description template, verification, common mistakes.
- `content-guidelines.md`: Voice-neutral UX writing mechanics — capitalization, button labels, error messages, empty states, punctuation. Brand voice/tone is left to the consuming product.
- `enpath-tone-and-voice.md`: Enpath's own layer on top of the above — HR-platform-specific tone (a score is development information, not a verdict), admin vs. employee voice, HR/engineering jargon to avoid, reversible-action copy pattern. Enpath-specific, not part of the reusable design system.
- Collaboration workflow — propose before executing, never fix without approval. **Lives outside this system**, in the vault at Working process - L&D/Diary/Claude-collaboration.md, and is mirrored into Claude memory. Not vendored here, so it is not a path this index can verify.

---

## Component Documentation

55 components — each has one `meta.json` (the **only** spec) and a Storybook story. There is no separate Markdown page per component (removed 2026-09-25): the readable spec is `meta.json` → `docs`, and Variant Matrix, Do Not, Usage Rules and Accessibility are the structured fields `variants`, `doNot`, `constraints` and `accessibility`.

- `Machine Readable/artifacts/shared/form-shared.docs.json`: Shared spec for the form sub-components `label`, `menu-dropdown`, `menu-dropdown-item`.
- `Machine Readable/component-doc-template.md`: Section-by-section guide for writing a new component's `docs` (was `_template.md`).

---

## Machine-Readable Artifacts

**55 meta.json files** — one per component, v3 schema.

- `Machine Readable/artifacts/components/[name].meta.json`: Structured metadata — variants (`reactProp`/`reactValues`), tokens per state (including invalid ring spec), storybook reference, implementation notes, known issues, changelog, behavior typeGuide. **Read before any component work.**
- `Machine Readable/component-quick-reference.md`: **Scan before building any screen.** What each component is for, key usage rule, common mistake, comparison to similar components. Hand-maintained from meta.json — all 55 components.
- `Machine Readable/component-directory.md`: Directory of all 55 components with Storybook title and tsx file, generated from meta.json.
- `Machine Readable/meta-artifact-template.md`: **v3 template** — all required fields documented. Read before generating or updating any meta.json.
- `Machine Readable/generation-rules.md`: When and how to regenerate meta.json — triggered by code changes, story changes, doc updates, bug fixes.
- `Machine Readable/validate-artifacts.mjs`: Validation script — run with `node "Machine Readable/validate-artifacts.mjs"` to check all 55 meta.json files.
- `Machine Readable/sync-doc-values.mjs`: **Rewrites restated px values from `Tokens/*.json`.** Docs name a token then restate its value (`spacing/component/lg (16px)`). The name is right forever; the number is a hand-typed snapshot that goes stale the moment a primitive changes — so a single re-theme edit invalidates ~180 of them at once. This makes them derived instead of authored. Dry-run by default; `--write` applies. **Run after any token value change, before committing.** Never hand-type a px next to a token name again.
- `Machine Readable/drift-check.mjs`: **Drift detector** — run `node "Machine Readable/drift-check.mjs"`. Checks (1) every path in llms.txt resolves, (2) component-count claims match meta.json files, (3) no hex values in any doc or meta.json — values live only in `Tokens/`, (4) control heights use tokens, paired touch + pointer, (5) every story is owned by a meta.json, (6) every restated px value matches the token it names, (7) no retired tooling or deleted files are mentioned, (8) every meta.json `docs` section is well-formed, (9) every token a meta.json names exists, component tokens included, (10) component-directory.md and component-quick-reference.md entries match each meta.json description, (11) no em dashes in UI copy, (12) meta.json, component comments and docs name text styles, never their values (fonts, weights, sizes, text-sm, font-medium), (13) .tsx class strings use text styles: no text-xs…9xl, text-[Npx], leading-*, font-mono/sans, font-medium/bold (exceptions: lone font-semibold / font-normal for states and inline emphasis, tracking-wide / -widest). Exit 1 on drift. Run after renames/moves, token edits, or component changes.

**Note:** `examples.tsx` files deleted 2026-06-03. Examples now live in `src/stories/*.stories.tsx`. The `storybook` field in each meta.json references the story file path and named exports.

---

## Storybook

- `enpath-ui/src/stories/[Name].stories.tsx`: **55 story files** — interactive demos for all components. Verification status per component in `Tracking/Storybook Status.md` (not all verified).
- `enpath-ui/src/components/ui/[name].tsx`: Component implementation files — all tokens spec-fixed.
- `enpath-ui/src/app/tokens.css`: **Generated** by `Tokens/sd.build.mjs` — every token as a CSS custom property (`:root`, light mode only). Never edit by hand.
- `enpath-ui/.storybook/preview.tsx`: Storybook config — light mode only; backgrounds: default / muted.

---

## Screen Design (Storybook prototypes)

Guides for designing full product screens using real components + Tailwind in Storybook.

- `Prototype-build/composition/`: **Read before building any screen.** Screen-building guidance vendored from En UI — composition decision record (`composition-quality.md`), exploration, pattern contracts, common generated-UI mistakes (`anti-slop-catalog.md`), screenshot review gate (`rendered-validation.md`, `visual-quality-loop.md`), WCAG 2.2 AA policy. Each file opens with an En UI → Enpath override table.

**Screen stories** live in `enpath-ui/src/stories/screens/` (title `Screens/Feature/Name`) and render the prototype's code — no duplicate. Current: `Screens/Setup/Career structure`.

## Product documents

- `document/`: product build docs (moved into the repo 2026-09-28). The PRDs are not in the repo: they stay in the Obsidian vault, in the Enpath folder's "original brief" folder.
- `document/glossary.md`: terms, data model and the development loop (Target → Assessment → Growth areas → Action plan → Evidence). Use its vocabulary.
- `document/set-up-build.md`: Setup — key decisions, what's built, open questions.
- `document/my-career-build.md`: My Career — key decisions, what's built, How the map works, open questions.
- `document/my-actions-build.md`: My Actions / Action plan (PRD-022) — decisions, not built.
- `document/my-assessment-build.md`: Assessment (no PRD) — decisions, not built.
- `document/market-research.md`: Progression, Lattice, Leapsome, Culture Amp, Pave.

## Prototype (Next.js app)

Run `cd enpath-ui && npm run dev` → `http://localhost:3000/setup`. Mock data only — a refresh resets it. Restart the dev server (and `rm -rf .next`) after `.tsx` or token changes.

- `enpath-ui/src/app/setup/page.tsx`: the Setup route.
- `enpath-ui/src/app/me/career/page.tsx`: the My Career route.
- `enpath-ui/src/features/enpath/app-shell.tsx`: app shell — transparent floating sidebar + page panel + optional right panel, on `color/background/app` Sidebar links to the two built routes, `/setup` and `/me/career`; other items show a placeholder.
- `enpath-ui/src/features/enpath/mock-data.ts`: Positions, Levels (with headcount), Matrices, expectations.
- `enpath-ui/src/features/enpath/setup/`: `setup-screen.tsx` (Career structure tab, grid, Publish / Unpublish) · `position-dialog.tsx` (Create / Edit position).
- `enpath-ui/src/features/enpath/my-career/`: `my-career-screen.tsx` (route `/me/career` — employee view for Lan: progress strip + Career Map (status-band cards, routes coloured by role, legend of routes on the map) + a detail panel that follows the selection, with gap rows, Set as target, company-path picker, Explore a position, Career visions + request, Remove) · `gap-row.tsx` · `plan-dialogs.tsx` · `mock-data.ts` (Lan's plan; Positions and Levels come from Setup's mock). Spec: `document/my-career-build.md`.
- `enpath-ui/src/features/enpath/chat/chat-panel.tsx`: AI chat panel (mock streaming, Ask / Edit, proposal → Edit position).
- `enpath-ui/src/components/ai-elements/`: [AI Elements](https://elements.ai-sdk.dev/) source (conversation, message, prompt-input, model-selector, suggestion, tool, reasoning, shimmer, code-block) — Phosphor icons, light only, bound to `chat/*` tokens. Documented like every component (meta.json → generated page, stories under `AI/…`), as are the ui primitives it added (collapsible, command, dropdown-menu, hover-card, input-group, scroll-area, spinner).

## Tracking

- `Tracking/Storybook Status.md`: Per-component pipeline status — `.tsx` tokens, story written, story verified in browser.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: Breaking changes, additions and removals, newest first. Starts 2026-09-21 (Enpath creation).

## Tokens

Three-tier architecture: Primitives → Semantics → Components.

- `Tokens/primitives.tokens.json`: 191 raw primitive tokens (colour, spacing, radius, type, shadow, motion, opacity, z-index, breakpoints, layout) — DTCG format.
- `Tokens/semantics.tokens.json`: 128 semantic tokens (background, surface, brand, border, text, input, icon, status, sidebar, spacing, radius roles, shadow roles, height, opacity) — DTCG format.
- `Tokens/components.tokens.json`: 46 component tokens (button, badge, tooltip, table) — DTCG format.
- `Tokens/output/css/variables.css`: 360 resolved CSS custom properties — the build's raw output, copied into `tokens.css`.
- `Tokens/output/css/tailwind-v4.css`: Same values as `@theme` block for Tailwind v4.
- `Tokens/output/js/tokens.mjs`: ES module token constants.
- `Tokens/sd.build.mjs`: Style Dictionary v5 build — run `node sd.build.mjs` after editing any `*.tokens.json`. Writes the output folder and `enpath-ui/src/app/tokens.css`.
- `Tokens/patch-style-dictionary.mjs`: Runs on `npm install` (postinstall). Re-applies the Style Dictionary patch that lets a token also have child tokens (`color/brand/primary` + `/foreground`). Without it every `/foreground` reference breaks the build.
